searchText: I have heard that right after the merge, there will be "skinny withdraws," allowing 4 validators to exit per slot. Is this true? <dannyryan> Validators can already exit ~4 per slot <dannyryan> Any withdrawal mechanism will allow *at least* 4 withdrawals per slot to mirror this exit throttle <dannyryan> this is not “skinny withdrawals”, it’s just withdrawals <dannyryan> Withdrawals CL tracking issue here — https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/2758 and meta-spec here — https://notes.ethereum.org/@ralexstokes/Skp1mPSb9
